scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Capital Investment In Solar Power Generation
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Should be a new manufacturing or service unit or an existing manufacturing or service unit undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector
The unit must have commenced commercial production between 20.05.2022 and 19.05.2027
Enterprise must meet at least 10 % of its total power consumption through solar power
Application must be submitted within six months of generation of solar power
Enterprise is eligible for the scheme only once
benefits_summary: 25 % subsidy up to a maximum of ₹5,000,000
